name: Statistic-Display
description: An easy statistics tracker for Minecraft Bedrock Edition.

releases.name: v1.3.0 for MC 26.30+ & Canopy 1.5.7
releases.notes:
### __What's new__
- **__Minecraft 26.30+ Support__**
- **Stabilized**: Statistic Display will no longer require manual updates for every minor Minecraft update.
  - `chatsSent` statistic has been removed to make this possible.

releases.name: v1.2.2 for MC 26.20 & Canopy 1.5.6
releases.notes:
### __What's new__
- **__Minecraft 26.20 Support__**
- `blocksMinedWith` (including every type of item): Tracks what item you were holding when you broke blocks.

releases.name: v1.2.0 for MC 26.0 & Canopy 1.5.3
releases.notes:
### __What's new__
- **__Minecraft 26.0 Support__**
- A complete switch to vanilla commands! `./stat` is now `/stat:stat`, `/stat:list`, `/stat:print`, `/stat:reset`, and `/stat:carousel`. Their usage is available on the project's GitHub repo.
- `carouselInterval` rule to set the display time for each carousel statistic.
- `showOfflinePlayers` rule to show or hide offline players in the statistic display.
- `showTotal` rule to show or hide the total count in the statistic display.
- `itemsPickedUp` statistic (including each type of item)
- `itemsDropped` statistic (including each type of item)
### __Improvements__
- The `<statistic>` argument now accepts input case-insensitively.
- Improved world load time for worlds with many saved statistics.

*... and more improvements behind the scenes!*

releases.name: v1.1.8 for MC 1.21.100 & Canopy 1.4.1
releases.notes:
### __What's new__
- **__Minecraft 1.21.100 Support__**
- `./stat [statistic] print` - Fixed incorrect descriptions of this command.

releases.name: v1.1.7 for MC 1.21.90 & Canopy 1.3.9
releases.notes:
### __What's new__
- **__Minecraft 1.21.90 Support__**
- `totemsPopped` - A new statistic for tracking Totem of Undying usages.
### __Improvements__
- `./stat list [statistic/searchterm]` - Revamped `./stat list` to show much less data and allow for search terms.

releases.name: v1.1.6 for MC 1.21.70 & Canopy v1.3.9
releases.notes:
## What's New  
- **__Minecraft 1.21.70 Support__**  
- **__Canopy v1.3.9 Support__**  
- **`commandStat` rule removed**: The `stat` command is now usable by default. 
## Improvements  
- **`toolsBroken` fix**: No longer triggers for unbreaking-enchanted tools that haven’t yet broken.

releases.name: v1.1.4 for MC 1.21.50 & Canopy 1.3.7
releases.notes:
## New Features
- **`other` category**: Displays world-wide statistics, including:
  - World Initializations.
  - Highest Player Count Online.
## Improvements
- **Compatibility**: Added support for **Canopy v1.3.7**.

releases.name: v1.1.2 for MC 1.21.41 & Canopy 1.3.5
releases.notes:
## New Features
- **`timeSinceDeath`**: Tracks minutes since last player death.
- **`damageDealt`**: Tracks when players deal damage to entities.
- **`damageTaken`**: Tracks when players take damage, with sub-stats for damage sources.
- **`chats`**: Tracks when players send messages in chat.
- **`joins`**: Tracks player join events.
- **`emotes`**: Tracks when players perform emotes.
## Improvements
- **Carousel display**: Now pauses automatically when manually setting the display to a specific statistic.
- **General maintenance**: Removed `./transferstats` command (use prior version if still needed).

releases.name: v1.1.1 for MC 1.21.41 & Canopy v1.3.5
releases.notes:
Updated dependencies to Minecraft 1.21.41. 
## New Features
- **`effectsGained`**: Tracks when players gain effects, with sub-stats for each effect.
- **`changedDimensions`**: Tracks when players change dimensions, with sub-stats for each dimension.

releases.name: v1.1.0 for MC 1.21.31 & Canopy 1.3.4
releases.notes:
## New Features
- **Backend rewrite**: Now uses a single `statDisplay` objective for all statistics, removing the maximum limit of tracked stats.
- **`./stat <statistic> print [player]`**: Prints the top 15 players for a stat or just the specified player.
- **`./stat toggle [total/offline]`**: Toggles between total or offline player stats.
- **`./stat carousel <start/stop>`**: Starts or stops the statistic carousel.
- **`./stat carousel <add/remove>`**: Adds or removes a statistic from the carousel.
- **`./stat carousel list`**: Lists all carousel statistics.
- **`./stat carousel interval [seconds]`**: Sets carousel change intervals.
- **`toolsBroken`**: Tracks when players break tools, including tool-specific stats.
- **`highestXpLevel`**: Tracks the highest XP level achieved by players.
- **`./transferstats`**: Transfers stats from v1.0.0 to v1.1.0, cleaning up old data.

## Improvements
- **`./stat clear`** renamed to **`./stat hide`** for clarity.

releases.name: v1.0.0 for MC 1.21.30 & Canopy v1.3.3
releases.notes:
## Commands & Rules
- **`commandStat`**: Enables or disables the stat command.
- **`./stat <statistic>`**: Displays the specified statistic in the sidebar.
- **`./stat list`**: Lists all available statistics.
- **`./stat clear`**: Clears the sidebar.
- **`./stat <statistic> reset`**: Resets all counts for a specific statistic.
## Available Statistics
- **`deaths`**: Tracks player deaths.
- **`blocksMined` & `blocksMined_[block_id]`**: Tracks total blocks mined and specific blocks.
- **`blocksPlaced` & `blocksPlaced_[block_id]`**: Tracks total blocks placed and specific blocks.
- **`itemsUsed` & `itemsUsed_[item_id]`**: Tracks items used and specific items.
- **`killed` & `killed_[entity_id]`**: Tracks entities killed and specific entities.
- **`killedBy` & `killedBy_[entity_id]`**: Tracks player deaths by entity and specific entities.
- **`interactedWith` & `interactedWith_[block_id/entity_id]`**: Tracks interactions with blocks or entities.
